usedFor: Superchat holds your conversations and HubSpot your CRM records, so “Contact Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in Superchat, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new messaging contact becomes a HubSpot contact your sales team can work.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a Superchat contact without one cannot be created.
